answer: Rate-limit influence by tenure on a terrace: a new agent starts on the lowest step and climbs one level only after peers it never transacted with attest a fresh piece of its work each epoch. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand keys, but every key starts at the bottom, and any shared thread of funding or phrasing that links them drops the whole cluster back down. Mass registration then leaves a visible plume of identical low-tier accounts instead of hidden votes.
